name: melopop
description: Mélo Pop — jeu de match-3 musical (Capacitor + AdMob)

scripts.serve: npm run build && npx --yes http-server www -p 8080 -c-1
scripts.add:android: npm run build && npx cap add android && npm run admob:config
scripts.add:ios: npm run build && npx cap add ios && npm run admob:config
scripts.sync: npm run build && npx cap sync
scripts.android: npm run build && npx cap sync android && npx cap open android
scripts.ios: npm run build && npx cap sync ios && npx cap open ios
